mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL inflation index above 3% for two consecutive months predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to market anticipation of tighter policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in all CPIAUCSL > 3.0 regimes, or inflation decelerates within 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% coincides with stronger S&P 500 20-day forward returns as firms pass cost increases to consumers via higher valuations.
failure_condition: Payrolls data show no correlation between PAYEMS increases and subsequent SPX 20d returns, or IC < 0.05 in out-of-sample tests.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO manufacturing index below 100 suggests supply-side weakness, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns as market anticipates slower growth.
failure_condition: 60-day returns remain positive during INDPRO < 100 periods, or IC > 0.1 in walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in HOUST retail sales above 2% generate a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals resilient consumer demand.
failure_condition: No significant return correlation in out-of-sample periods, or HOUST increases fail to precede positive 20d returns.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% in a single month, the S&P 500 60-day forward return turns negative as markets price in higher future borrowing costs.
failure_condition: IC > 0.05 over 60-day windows after such triggers, or 60-day returns are non-negative during rate hike periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in UNRATE above 4% for three consecutive months is associated with negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns due to expectations of slower hiring and weaker growth.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.0 and UNRATE previous two months also > 3.5
failure_condition: IC > 0.1 in regimes with UNRATE > 4%, or returns are positive when trigger is met.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in both GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (retail sales) above their 12-month averages produce a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return, reflecting dual demand signals.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > GDPC1 12m avg AND RSAFS > RSAFS 12m avg
failure_condition: No significant return in out-of-sample periods when both proxies exceed their 12-month averages simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO falls for two consecutive months below 98, the S&P 20-day forward return turns negative as market anticipates supply-side softness.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are non-negative during such double-month declines, or IC > 0.15 in walk-forward evaluation.
